A Practical AI Marketing Plan for a Small Business

A simple way to choose useful AI applications without adding more tools than your team can manage.

By DIGITAL ARUNSample article5 min read
IN THIS ARTICLE
Start with a business problemChoose one focused use caseBuild a small testMeasure and improve
Sample article — replace or approve before publication.

A simple way to choose useful AI applications without adding more tools than your team can manage.

Start with a business problem

Before choosing a tool, identify where the customer experience or your team’s workflow currently slows down. Common examples include delayed inquiry replies, inconsistent content planning, and scattered customer information.

Choose one focused use case

Pick an opportunity with a clear owner and a measurable outcome. Document what happens today, what should happen next, and where a human should review the output.

Build a small test

Try the new workflow on a limited set of tasks. Check quality, privacy, and time saved before expanding it.

Measure and improve

Review whether the change helped customers or the team. Keep the useful pieces, revise weak steps, and avoid automating a broken process.

THE TAKEAWAY

Better growth starts with a clear customer problem, a focused action, and a way to learn from the result.
